notes.fixtures: Both full-scale fixtures: host schema created by the stock host's `lumae-install init`, then `seed_representative.py --host-schema audiomuse` (host_schema 'audiomuse'). local_runner used the P0-3 `it-` item ids; stock_host was re-seeded with `fp_4` content ids (seed.py --item-ids canonical).
notes.review_follow_up: Runs named local_runner_scale_0_02_* and mutation_* were made at scale 0.02 with the review-fixed harness (8 kill points, direct re-analysis checks, fixture guard, --explain-analyze). The mutation runs apply a plugin mutation (silent edge DELETE on an identical completion) or an emptied edge table and are expected to FAIL. All other runs used the harness at 928e52d.
